1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.e3 e6 5.Nf3.strategy: Develops the bishop to its most active diagonal, aimed at h7, and prepares to castle. If Black takes on c4, the bishop must recapture there and White loses a tempo, but White accepts that to keep the centre and play for a long positional game.

Takes the pawn exactly when the bishop has committed to d3: it has to retake on c4, so White loses a tempo. Black gives up the d5-pawn's grip on the centre but gains time to free the position with a central pawn break.
